episodes.synopsis: On the colony of Side 6, 11-year-old Alfred Izuruha messes around in school with his friends during lunch. As Al walks home, he bumps into his old friend Christina MacKenzie, who had moved to Earth years before.
episodes.title: How Many Miles to the Battlefield?

episodes.synopsis: Al takes pictures of the damaged Zaku and sees the pilot pointing a gun at him.
episodes.title: Reflections in a Brown Eye

episodes.synopsis: Al holds on to Garcia's truck as it drives through the city.
episodes.title: And At the End of the Rainbow?

episodes.synopsis: Al sneaks through the conduit back to Bernie and tells him he got pictures of a Federation mobile suit.
episodes.title: Over the River and Through the Woods

episodes.synopsis: Killing is informed that Operation Rubicon has failed and that the Gundam is still in Side 6.
episodes.title: Say It Ain't So, Bernie!

episodes.synopsis: Al and Bernie repair the damaged Zaku to fight the Alex Gundam.
episodes.title: War In the Pocket
